description: This file defines CLI commands for memory management, including status, index, search, and promote functionalities, with associated options and help texts.

methods.name: loadMemoryCliRuntime
methods.description: Loads the memory CLI runtime asynchronously, caching the promise.

methods.name: runMemoryStatus
methods.description: Executes the memory status command with given options.

methods.name: runMemoryIndex
methods.description: Executes the memory index command with given options.

methods.name: runMemorySearch
methods.description: Performs a memory search with specified query and options.

methods.name: runMemoryPromote
methods.description: Runs the memory promote command with given options.

methods.name: registerMemoryCli
methods.description: Registers CLI commands related to memory management into a commander program.
